scope: prediction only; no option strategy selection; no untouched holdout access
baseline: training-fold-only prevalence probability, clipped only by a pre-registered numerical epsilon

multiplicity.family_definition: must be frozen by tester-approved analysis plan before fitting

INTRA_30M_UP_DOWN.definition: sign of NIFTY spot return over next 30 minutes, fully contained within same trading session
INTRA_30M_UP_DOWN.flat_return: excluded from directional two-class metric; exclusion count reported

POS_1D_UP_DOWN.definition: sign of next-trading-session close-to-close NIFTY spot return
POS_1D_UP_DOWN.flat_return: excluded from directional two-class metric; exclusion count reported

calibration: fit only inside inner chronological training folds; never on validation/evaluation rows
data_policy: features must be available by forecast decision time; no lookahead; source and timestamp provenance required
gate: No empirical fitting until all NOT_FROZEN_BLOCKED fields are specified and independently approved.

amendment.reason: Freeze the exact statistical meaning of registered Markov transition_prior=2/5 before any empirical results, without changing the prediction-only scope or granting empirical authorization.
amendment.statement: All previously NOT_FROZEN_BLOCKED fields remain blocked; this amendment does not authorize fitting.

tester_review.scope: code contract only; not approval for empirical fitting
